name: chartwright-monorepo
description: Natural-language charts in your own process: an agentic loop inspects your data locally, a deterministic compiler emits chart-library options.

scripts.dev: npm run build:lib && npm run dev --workspace examples/react-highcharts
scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build --workspace examples/react-highcharts
scripts.verify: npm run build:lib && npm run typecheck --workspace chartwright && npm run typecheck:example && node scripts/verify-tests.mjs && npm run showcase -- --check && npm run pack:check
